retrieval_policy.current_job: Do not fetch external content. Classify only the snapshot and author a self-contained kickoff.
retrieval_policy.link_rule: A URL proves that a pointer was cataloged; it does not prove reachability, availability, authority, license, or instructional-unit status.
later_public_retrieval: Use only an explicitly authorized retrieval job and public sources whose access terms permit the operation.
Record canonical URL, retrieval outcome, source identity, license or terms, content hash, and retrieval time.
Validate content type and relevance before converting a resource into a proposed unit.
Preserve failed retrieval evidence and keep unavailable status until verification succeeds.
retrieval_policy.restricted_content: Never bypass authentication, enrollment controls, paywalls, robots restrictions, or other access controls; never copy hidden graders, solutions, secrets, or sealed references into learner-visible artifacts.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: Only independently validated, provenance-bearing material may be promoted from a pointer to available material, and availability alone does not make it an official course unit.
